d:
Officers uncover bizarre contraband at the airport, from suspected counterfeit skincare injections and shoddy construction equipment to illegal fish, mysterious items, and a foul-smelling shipment of illegal feces.
Stream Full Episodes of Contraband: Seized at the Airport
About Contraband: Seized at the Airport
Contraband: Seized at the Airport is a behind-the-scenes look at the Department of Homeland Security's search for domestic and foreign contraband.
